svg.title: LandOS Spatial Data Overlay icon-only review
svg.desc: A focused review board for the layered spatial intelligence icon at large and small sizes with light and dark home screen previews.
svg.text: Layered parcel intelligence, analytical nodes and a dense topographic field.
IOS ROUNDED-SQUARE MASK · SQUARE SVG SOURCE
Three translucent land-data planes · active parcel boundaries · connected analysis nodes
No numbers, pins, houses or surveying clip art. Topographic texture remains visible behind the full stack.
